claims.claim: Using Claude Opus 4.5, Numina-Lean-Agent solves all 12 Putnam 2025 problems, matching AXIOM's 12/12 in the comparison table (Table 1).
claims.evidence: The logbook confirms all 12 released Putnam 2025 proofs kernel-check without sorryAx, but explicitly states this does not establish that the named agent generated them; no rerun of Claude Opus 4.5 or the agent was performed.
